scope.initialPlatform: Explicitly qualified local Windows runtime/filesystem only

hostedSupervisor.requires: PowerShell7 Windows and Node20.19.0 from Get-Command

diagnosticHelperPairPreflight.sourceCopyAssertion: Strip each of13 exact known stderr-only insertion lines once; remaining normalized bytes equal frozen original8bf
diagnosticHelperPairPreflight.helperTransport: actual owned spawnSync for PID/status on success or timeout; direct tool probe, not core observeOwner acceptance
diagnosticHelperPairPreflight.workflowComposition: Root owns existing checks.yml descendant; no push before composition

hostedZeroCaseFailure.cause: Get-Command returned multiple Application paths, invoked as a joined string

candidateCases.assert: One acknowledged claim, exact logical owner/claim/lease coupling; conflicting later request denied.

candidateCases.schedule: Hold A after actual mutex acquisition; observe B acquisition attempt without forcing B past the lock; release A.
candidateCases.assert: Exactly one new claim ACK, no lost acknowledged claim; B busy/wait then fresh retry cannot claim the overlap.

candidateCases.schedule: Two real temporary Git worktrees resolve the same explicit synthetic authority.
candidateCases.assert: Same authority identity/mutex/journal; one winner, not two independent worktree corpora.

candidateCases.cut: After fully staged prepare and before commit marker
candidateCases.assert: Prior consistent state retained; no committed result invented; retry rechecks current ownership.

candidateCases.cut: After commit marker and after each canonical-file replacement
candidateCases.assert: Read-only export refuses pending recovery; committed recovery completes same revision and claim with no orphan or duplicate transition.

candidateCases.schedule: Hold live writer after one physical file replacement; issue trusted read/export.
candidateCases.assert: Reader blocks or returns explicit unavailable/recovery-required, never accepted mixed state.

candidateCases.cut: After clean publication, before stdout acknowledgement
candidateCases.assert: Same operation/actor/input returns recorded minimal result and original revision without a new lease/message/handoff/transition.

candidateCases.cut: Interrupt after a subset of committed after-images is materialized
candidateCases.assert: Next recovery is idempotent; trusted final snapshot is complete and retains original owner.
Same operation ID with changed actor, command, target or fingerprint is refused without disclosing/replaying another actor's receipt.
Live/paused mutex owner is not stolen on TTL, stale heartbeat or uncertain observation; logical task lease never auto-released by CLI death.
Reclamation requires exact namespace and process-birth proof; reused PID cannot impersonate original owner.
Only expected-token marker is removed; nonrecursive removal never deletes a new nonempty live mutex.
Malformed/partial/invalid-hash decided journal yields explicit unavailable, not green validation or guessed rollback.
Canonical hash outside recorded before/after values is preserved and fails closed; no blind overwrite.
Unsupported task/lease coupling and aggregate/individual-session disagreement are diagnosed, never normalized into fabricated authority.
Missing/ambiguous binding, incompatible protocol/host/filesystem and unqualified alternate clone refuse mutations without installing a second authority.
Case, separator, dot-segment and trailing-dot/space aliases normalize before the unchanged matcher; conflicting claim refuses with unchanged revision and the next heartbeat succeeds.
Case-folded duplicate session IDs and reserved device IDs refuse before COMMIT; no aliased file after-images, unchanged revision and next ordinary operation succeeds.
Maximum supported 100-character task/session IDs publish and replay a 241-character handoff basename using a fixed 110-character sibling temporary.

candidateCases.schedule: Real trusted death proof, then hold before-owner-unlink for more than3 seconds.
candidateCases.assert: One immediate atomic attempt after reclamation reaches recovery_required; exact recovery/replay preserves original claim.

candidateCases.schedule: Hold the old-token unlink beyond3 seconds; another actual CLI acquires and holds a new populated mutex.
candidateCases.assert: Late old unlink cannot remove replacement; failed rename returns busy before another probe/removal; winner and subsequent ordinary operation remain usable.
